limitations: Agent-authored; pending human validation; not an independently authored holdout.
Freeze before running; no training/RAG ingestion; after tuning treat as development data.
evaluation_scope: Frozen-source TechCare assistant, not open-domain general knowledge. O01–O10 measure scope adherence; O11–O20 measure missing business data handling.
directory_note: Historical folder name retained. v4.0-draft aligns 100 cases with the 150-product corpus; no claim of exhaustive product coverage.
history_protocol: 20 H scenarios, 4–5 user turns each. Fresh chat per scenario; generate and retain all actual assistant replies. Score only the final reply using actual context and reference meaning.

migration.reason: Removed Alldocube replaced with source-supported Teclast 128GB versus unverified 256GB variant. Remaining 98 cases unchanged.
migration.results_policy: Use a fresh run with the frozen 150-product corpus. Do not mix prior-version responses or scores.
